lines.text: You've run for a bus. This guy ran for the wrong one for three weeks.
Observe the office commuter, in his natural habitat.
Eight fourteen. Rohan hunts the eight fifteen shuttle.
Week one. He sprints. The doors shut on his nose.
Week two. A shoe flies off. The bus does not care.
Week three. Laptop, tiffin, toothbrush still in his mouth.
He gains. He leaps. The driver waves bye.
So, cunning. A daily chai, if the driver waits two minutes.
The driver drinks the chai. Leaves at eight fifteen.
Then the guard finally speaks.
Sir. That is a school bus.
Your shuttle got cancelled in June. Check your email.
Thirty kids have been cheering him on. Daily.
Lesson: the best ride is the one that waits for you.
So the herd evolved. It got itself an app.
Four neighbours, one pool. The roster picks whose car goes.
The live map: two hundred metres out.
Rohan finishes brushing, strolls out. Car's right there.
No sprint. A rare sight in the wild.
The school bus still slows at his gate. For the chai.
Sprinting for your ride every morning? Try Sahyatri. Link in bio.
